description: This file defines a functional interface 'PreEnforcer' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for applying pre-enforcement logic asynchronously to signals encapsulated in 'WithDittoHeaders'. The interface includes a default method for handling errors during pre-enforcement, with logging and error translation to a 'GatewayInternalErrorException'. It pertains to components involved in processing signals within the enforcement services of the Concorde module.

classes.name: PreEnforcer
classes.description: A functional interface representing a pre-enforcement step for processing signals asynchronously, with built-in error handling and logging.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Defines the core pre-enforcement logic that transforms a 'WithDittoHeaders' signal into a future result.

methods.name: withErrorHandlingAsync
methods.description: Performs pre-enforcement with error handling; on failure, logs the error and responds with a 'GatewayInternalErrorException', returning an alternative result.
